title: Profitable email signal engine
purpose: Build and evaluate a causal, signal-only email advisory engine without authorizing orders, account access, position management, or automatic trading.

historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0028: Historical negative/reference evidence only; never an independent validation set for this experiment.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0030: Historical negative/reference evidence only; its strategy is not optimized or reused as a winner.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0032: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no family, parameter, symbol, or outcome is used to tune this experiment.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0033: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no tournament result is used to select this experiment.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0034: Only its hash-locked public source manifest is reused as a raw-data provenance reference; its outcomes are not reused.
historicalReferences.HY-DATA-0036: Forward microstructure collection remains paused and is not required for this historical signal-only objective.
historicalReferences.rule: Any post-outcome change to a candidate rule, feature, model, cost, frequency, exit, universe, or gate voids this experiment and requires a new experiment ID.

primarySources: Binance official public USD-M historical archive: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um
Binance official public USD-M REST only where already hash-locked in the source manifest
dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Any missing, duplicate, non-contiguous, non-finite, out-of-window, hash-mismatched, non-causal, or unproven row rejects the affected source and prevents a PASS. No silent repair.

universe.eligibility: Only these eight symbols with complete causal required streams in the hash-locked source manifest. No later symbol list may add, remove, or rescue a symbol.

candidateGenerator.name: BROAD_BIDIRECTIONAL_15M_CAUSAL_CANDIDATES
candidateGenerator.decision: Every completed 15m decision for every fixed symbol emits an independent BUY candidate and an independent SELL candidate when all frozen feature inputs are complete.
candidateGenerator.regime: BULL, BEAR, or SIDEWAYS context from completed 4h causal breadth; SIDEWAYS is NO_TRADE context.

referenceTrade.entry: first contract-price 5m OPEN after decisionTime; exact boundary required
referenceTrade.atr: ATR20 from completed 1h contract-price bars available no later than decisionTime
referenceTrade.timeExit: Exact contract-price 5m OPEN at 12 hours; missing boundary is non-final and rejects the row.
referenceTrade.overlap: Same-symbol direction cooldown equals the 12-hour reference trade; no pyramiding or reversal.
referenceTrade.funding: Every realized funding event strictly within the held interval is applied separately using actual side and mark price.

costs.charge: One frozen all-in execution cost budget per entry and exit fill; source-embedded costs are not charged twice.

features.availability: Every feature is frozen at decisionTime or earlier; missing, late, non-finite, or non-PIT input invalidates the candidate.
features.fundingRule: Only realized funding events with event time <= decisionTime are eligible; no future funding is used.

model.name: RIDGE_EXPECTED_RETURN_MODEL
model.trainingOnlyWinsorization: 1st/99th percentile fitted within the training fold
model.selection: Lambda may be selected only from Development OOF training folds; no validation outcome selection.

walkForward.method: Expanding purged walk-forward with OOF-only selection
walkForward.historicalValidationRetrain: Rolling monthly causal retrain using only the prior 365 days; a month outcome is never used before the next month.

frequency.sameDecisionSymbolSide: Keep only the higher predicted edge between BUY and SELL; exact deterministic tie-break.
frequency.crossSymbolRanking: Rank eligible candidates by predicted edge at the decision boundary.

developmentSelection.search: lambda x deterministic predicted-edge threshold grid only
developmentSelection.thresholdGrid: OOF predicted-edge empirical percentiles 90.0 through 99.9 on a fixed deterministic grid; computed within Development only.

emailPreparation.gating: EMAIL_PREPARED=true and EMAIL_ACTIVATED=false only after all historical gates pass
